blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around 25,000 participants recently gathered at Quirino Grandstand in Luneta Park for the annual Couples for Christ’s Ancop Global Walk, united by a shared mission to answer the cry of the poor through education, compassion, and service. Before sunrise, thousands of families and friends gathered for the walk, filling the grounds with a spirit of faith and solidarity. Ancop-sponsored students brought added energy to the event as they danced to the official Ancop Global Walk theme, while fur parents joined the crowd with their pets, making the gathering a celebration for the whole community.
